description: Open or close a single port on a server's edge firewall so it can (or can't) serve traffic. Does not charge money. Requires an account API key (AGENTMETAL_API_KEY) and ownership of the server. The last SSH (port 22) rule cannot be removed unless force:true (it would lock you out). Use action "open" to expose e.g. 443 for a web server, "close" to remove a rule.

action.description: "open" adds an allow rule; "close" removes the matching rule.

description.description: Optional human label for the rule.

force.description: Required (true) to remove the last SSH (22) rule; guards against locking yourself out.

port.description: Port or range for tcp/udp, e.g. "443" or "8000-9000". Omit for icmp/esp/gre.

protocol.description: Rule protocol. Most web/app ports are tcp.

source_ips.description: Allowed source CIDRs (e.g. ["0.0.0.0/0","::/0"]). Defaults to the whole internet.

name: manage_firewall
title: Open or close a firewall port
